intended_service.value: An engine oil additive for the formulation of Ultra High Performance Diesel (UHPD) lubricants meeting the requirements of ACEA E4, API CI-4 and MB-Approval 228.5 | Application: Diesel engines meeting Euro I, II, III, IV & V emission requirements and running under severe operating conditions. Suitable for use with NOx reduction systems.

Suitable for use with NOx reduction systems.
